patio.title: Patio
purpose: An educational 3D game for children aged 6 to 11 and a web panel for moderators. Each day a child solves a short set of challenges (drag and drop, number input, word drop) in a virtual schoolyard.
The panel lets moderators and administrators manage groups, players, challenges, daily sets and rules, and see stats. It works end to end but is not open to players yet.

steps: Game: open the link and choose an alias. No email, password or account is needed. You get a one-time recovery code to come back later.
Panel: for moderators and administrators, by invitation only. No demo credentials are provided.

built: React Three Fiber and Rapier for the 3D schoolyard, with an alien modeled in Blender. The panel is React with shadcn/Radix.
A NestJS API on Google Cloud Run with MongoDB Atlas. JSON Schema contracts are the single source of truth and generate the types and validators.
pnpm monorepo, GitHub Actions CI, game and panel on Cloudflare Pages. WCAG 2.2 AA, no analytics, ads or third-party SDKs.
why: I wanted a game where the goal is to understand a problem, not to spend more time on a screen: no streaks, rankings, timers or penalties. The level is computed on the server and never shown to the child.
I built it with AI-assisted development (Claude Code), keeping the decisions written down in the repo so the work can be resumed at any time.

provecheck.title: ProveCheck
purpose: A task-management suite for service companies. The admin assigns tasks, the field worker records arrival and finishes the task with photos and notes, and the client automatically gets a PDF by email.
Clients can file a complaint on a finished task and rate the workers from 1 to 5. There are three roles: administrator, collaborator and client user.

steps: Demo panel: sign in with the administrator credentials below.
Workers and clients use the Android app: download the APK, allow the install from an unknown source when Android asks, and sign in.
Accounts are created by the administrator with a temporary password. The first login asks for a new one.
The API runs on a free plan and sleeps when idle, so the first request can take up to 50 seconds. Wait and try again.

built: pnpm monorepo: Fastify API on Render, React and Vite panel with TanStack Query, Expo and React Native app, and a shared package with Zod schemas.
Supabase for Postgres, auth and files. Permissions are enforced in the API and again with row-level security.
PDFs are generated with react-pdf and sent by email in the background. Once a task is finished, its record cannot be edited.
why: Service companies often depend on reviews in Google Maps and on chat messages to prove the work was done. I wanted the evidence (photos, notes, PDF) and the client's feedback to live in the same place, tied to each task.
I wrote the spec first, with the business rules and roles, and then built it in slices with AI-assisted development.

coffeemaster.title: Coffee Master
purpose: A chat to learn how to brew better coffee at home. You ask a virtual barista and it answers by your name, with concrete advice.

It has a catalog of validated recipes (V60, French press, moka, espresso), a personal recipe book, quantity calculations and help fixing bitter or sour coffee. Nothing is saved without your confirmation.

steps: Create an account with your name, email and password.
Enter the 6-digit code that arrives by email, sign in and ask your first question.
Each user has a daily message limit.

built: Claude (Anthropic) for the chat, with answers grounded in a coffee guide written for the project. Optional semantic search (RAG) with pgvector.
Next.js on the web, Expo and React Native on Android, and a Python FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL on Supabase.
Answers stream with Server-Sent Events. The server keeps the history, so cost per message stays bounded, and it has rules against prompt injection and evaluation cases.
why: I wanted a useful AI product with clear limits: it proposes recipes but never edits yours, and it stays inside a verified guide.
It was developed with AI assistance: written rules, specs and evaluation cases keep the result consistent after every change.

about.title: Hi, I'm Eva.
intro: I'm a Product Engineer with more than six years of experience building digital products.

I started my career in web development, but curiosity has always pushed me beyond that. Today I enjoy working across the entire product lifecycle—from understanding requirements and designing user experiences to defining technical solutions and delivering them to production.
What motivates me isn't writing code for its own sake; it's building products that solve real problems and create value for users.
Outside of coding, I'm constantly exploring new technologies, especially AI-powered tools that help me work smarter and deliver better software.
experienceIntro: Over the last six years, I've had the opportunity to work on fintech products, educational and enterprise platforms, e-commerce, and cloud solutions.

My experience started in web development, evolved into technical leadership, and eventually expanded to product design, backend, automation, and software architecture. Today I'm building my own products as an independent engineer.
Each role has taught me something different, but they all share one thing in common: building products that people actually use.
about.experienceNote: A short tour of the path — the full story lives in the resume.

jobs.summary: Building products end-to-end with AI-assisted development: Coffee Master (AI barista chat powered by Claude, web and mobile, with streaming and per-user limits), Patio (a reasoning game for kids with a teacher panel) and ProveCheck (a field-service app).

Worked end-to-end, design to production, on wallet payment and checkout flows for users across four continents. Designed a multi-tenant architecture with Module Federation, built a multi-currency portal and a user-management panel from scratch, migrated apps from Create React App to Vite (~80% faster builds) and mentored a developer from junior to semi-senior.

jobs.company: IUGO Software & Design Studio by Domus Global · Montevideo, Uruguay
jobs.summary: Through staff augmentation at D24 and ERON International (payments), built merchant, admin and internal finance panels and led the redesign and rebrand of a creator payouts portal. Also built an admin panel and a user app with games, achievements and events for a kids' education platform.
Worked on web apps, e-commerce, corporate sites and cloud solutions with Azure, Power Platform, Vue/Nuxt and React.
Built landing pages and dashboards with Vue.js and D3.js, including a drag-and-drop UML diagram editor.
